name: pdfi-macro-docs
description: Checks of the macro API and docs/macros/api/, generated from pdfi.d.ts

scripts.docs:check: typedoc && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- ../../../docs/macros/api)" || (git status --short -- ../../../docs/macros/api; echo docs/macros/api is out of date: npm run docs; exit 1)
